precedence: This override supersedes conflicting or incomplete statements about ordinary Student Login Manager batch selection/provisioning only. All non-conflicting Portal V2, Replace Resource and shared-Worker composition authority remains binding.

change.name: Create a new batch from existing batch settings
change.workerImplementation: worker/src/admin-batch-manager-v2.js routed by worker/src/index-admin-tools.js; ordinary student provisioning remains in worker/src/admin-student-manager.js

requiredBehaviour.batchKeyRule: Canonicalise to uppercase and validate before mutation.
requiredBehaviour.templateRule: The selected existing batch is the settings template; the requested batch remains a distinct batch key and the template must be active on activeFrom.
requiredBehaviour.createTimestampRule: New batch rows must populate created_at and updated_at as required by the batch_definitions schema.
requiredBehaviour.activeFromRule: Use the requested activeFrom date for the new batch rather than inheriting the template start date.
requiredBehaviour.duplicateRule: If the batch key already exists, do not mutate it. Refresh the active list: if it is active, select it; otherwise show a short message that the code is already in use and require a different code.
requiredBehaviour.constraintClassificationRule: Only a true UNIQUE/primary-key collision on batch_definitions.batch_key is BATCH_ALREADY_EXISTS. Other SQL constraint failures must remain BATCH_CREATE_FAILED.
requiredBehaviour.postCreateUi: After successful creation, refresh active batches and select the new batch automatically when available, then continue with the ordinary Create Student Login flow.
requiredBehaviour.studentBoundary: Creating a batch never creates the student. Student provisioning remains a separate Create Student Login action with its existing prepared-read-model gates.
requiredBehaviour.dropdownPresentation: In Copy settings from, render at least one visible space between the batch code and its human-readable type/description.

incident20260925.symptom: Creating Y411OE2 displayed BATCH_ALREADY_EXISTS even though the batch did not appear in the active list.
incident20260925.rootCause: The first create implementation omitted required created_at and updated_at values. D1 raised a NOT NULL constraint error, and the Worker incorrectly classified any error containing the word constraint as BATCH_ALREADY_EXISTS.
incident20260925.repair: The active create handler supplies created_at and updated_at and classifies only a real batch_key UNIQUE/primary-key collision as BATCH_ALREADY_EXISTS.
incident20260925.uxDecision: Keep the Admin workflow simple: create batch -> batch is selected -> create student. Do not expose a separate reactivation workflow in Student Login Manager.

safetyAndPreservation: Do not overwrite, reactivate or repurpose an existing batch definition from Student Login Manager.
Do not create or modify a student merely by creating a batch definition.
Do not claim a requested batch or student exists until the authenticated mutation and readback complete.
Do not alter normal-student multi-device session semantics.
Do not alter Trial one-successful-login semantics.
Do not alter lesson release, prepared access projection, protected Answer Pack, PreLesson/VR or quiz-bridge behaviour.
Shared Worker production deployment must retain the composed quiz bridge -> Admin Tools chain and all existing preservation gates.

completionBoundary.engineeringChange: The repository supports simple batch creation with required timestamps, precise duplicate classification and automatic refresh/selection.
completionBoundary.productionMutation: A new batch is usable only after authenticated mutation, readback and appearance in the refreshed active-batch list.
completionBoundary.studentProvisioning: A student login is not provisioned until the separate create-student transaction and prepared access publication/readback gates succeed.

verificationMatrix: Verify unauthenticated batch creation remains rejected.
Verify new create populates required created_at and updated_at timestamps.
Verify a generic NOT NULL/CHECK constraint is not classified as BATCH_ALREADY_EXISTS.
Verify a real batch_key UNIQUE collision is classified as BATCH_ALREADY_EXISTS.
Verify an active duplicate is recovered by refresh + automatic selection without mutation.
Verify Student Login Manager exposes no reactivation action or reactivate endpoint call.
Verify the Admin dropdown retains visible separation between batch code and description.
After any shared Worker production deploy, rerun shared-capability regression gates.
authorityUpdateRule: If batch-definition fields, create endpoint shape, template-copy semantics, duplicate handling, provisioning coupling or validation rules change, update this override and GCH_CURRENT.json in the same coherent change.
